title: Tilley LTM3 Airflo Classic Sun Hat (Khaki/Olive, size 6 7/8)

comparisons.notes: Same LTM3 Airflo Classic Sun Hat in Khaki/Olive, size 6 7/8 in stock at $99 on tilley.com.

writeup: The Tilley LTM3 Airflo Classic Sun Hat in Khaki/Olive is $33.99 new on Woot, but only in size 6 7/8. It's UPF 50+, water repellent, floats, and has Airflo mesh ventilation plus snap-up side brims. Tilley sells the same hat for $99 on its own site.
